summary: Since 2.8, ansible_interpreter_python_fallback lists Python paths to try in order, making meta ports optional; set it in group_vars/all and override per group or host.
questions: How do I give Ansible a list of Python paths to try?
Do I need the FreeBSD python meta ports?

answer_card.title: Python interpreter fallback list
answer_card.answer_md:
```ini
ansible_interpreter_python_fallback=['/usr/local/bin/python', '/usr/local/bin/python3', '/usr/local/bin/python3.11']
```
The first path found is used, so without the meta ports Ansible finds `/usr/local/bin/python3.11`. Put it in `group_vars/all` and override in group or host vars as needed.
